title: Duel Decks: Divine vs. Demonic: card flavor text

entities.name: Akroma
entities.description: An angel of wrath who seeks vengeance against Phage and before whom even those born to battle lay their blades.

entities.name: Grelden
entities.description: A man blessed by an Icatian priest who wakes covered in enemy blood on the field of victory.

entities.name: Crovax
entities.description: A man whose family sheltered in an angel's light while the dark waited.

entities.name: Reya Dawnbringer
entities.description: An angel who declares that none have died until she consents.

entities.name: Calexis
aliases: deacon of the New Order of Serra
entities.description: A deacon of the New Order of Serra who warns that an angel's fixed stare blinds and burns.

entities.name: New Order of Serra
entities.description: A religious order devoted to the angel Serra.

entities.name: Rafiq of the Many
entities.description: A warrior who says he is never alone even in single combat.

entities.name: Phage the Untouchable
entities.description: A deadly figure who threatens her victims with their last words; Akroma vows to see her destroyed.

entities.name: Gerrard
entities.description: A crew member of the Weatherlight who threatens an Abyssal Gatekeeper.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: Gerrard's ship.

entities.name: Hob Heddil
entities.description: A speaker who warns how hard it is to remove a soot imp from a chimney.

entities.name: Lim-Dul
entities.description: A necromancer who prays to Leshrac for power.

entities.name: Leshrac
entities.description: A planeswalker and lord, addressed by Lim-Dûl as liege.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A necromancer planeswalker who learned secrets at a price etched on her fate.

entities.name: Geth
entities.description: Keeper of the Vault, who speaks of conquest and pawns.

entities.name: Mayvar
entities.description: A minion of Geth who claims the blood, marrow and spirit of victims.

entities.name: Serra
entities.description: An angel whose touch bears hopes aloft and empowers noble causes.

entities.name: Order of the Ebon Hand
entities.description: A group overwhelmed by thrulls bred at a terrifying pace.

entities.name: Numai
entities.description: A place where a journal was found describing a vision among fallen friends.

entities.name: Simic
entities.description: A Ravnican guild that uses imp claws as scalpels.

entities.name: Rakdos
entities.description: A Ravnican guild that uses imp claws for tattooing and torture.

entities.name: Gruul
entities.description: A Ravnican guild that uses imp claws as toothpicks.

events.summary: An Icatian priest blesses Grelden, who later comes to himself covered in his enemies' blood on the field of victory.
events.quote: Grelden knelt and felt the cool, dry hand of the priest on his brow.

events.summary: Crovax recalls his family sheltering in an angel's light while the dark was content to wait.
events.quote: My family sheltered in her light, the dark was content to wait.

events.summary: Akroma vows to keep fighting until the world unites in vengeful fury and Phage is destroyed.
events.quote: Until the world unites in vengeful fury and Phage is destroyed, I will not stay my hand.

events.summary: Gerrard threatens an Abyssal Gatekeeper that passing the gate involves the gatekeeper's staying conscious or not.
events.quote: There are two ways for me to pass this gate. One involves you remaining conscious.

events.summary: Lim-Dul calls on Leshrac for the power he is due.
events.quote: Leshrac, my liege, grant me the power I am due.

events.summary: Liliana Vess tells a victim she will deprive them only of their most precious secret.
events.quote: I'm not going to deprive you of all your secrets.

events.summary: Phage the Untouchable warns a victim that their next words will be their last.
events.quote: Choose your next words carefully. They will be your last.

events.summary: Liliana learns the secrets she sought at a price etched on her fate.
events.quote: Liliana learned the secrets she sought, but at a price that was etched on her fate.

events.summary: Thrulls bred at a terrifying pace overwhelm the Order of the Ebon Hand.
events.quote: In the end, they overwhelmed the Order of the Ebon Hand.

events.summary: Mayvar, minion of Geth, claims a victim's blood, marrow and spirit.
events.quote: Your blood, your marrow, your spirit

relations.note: Mayvar is identified as Geth's minion.
Akroma vows to see Phage destroyed.
relations.quote: Until the world unites in vengeful fury and Phage is destroyed, I will not stay my hand.
